searchText: https://eips.ethereum.org doesn't display EIPs in review state. See Networking category and notice that https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-2481 is missing from it. https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/master/_includes/eiptable.html#L10 appears to be where it builds the table from, but I don't know where `site.data.statuses` comes from. Found it I think, PR created to fix the issue: https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3162 <@!543900561460822016> Will you be around for a bit? If so I'll merge that PR and we can verify in production. If it doesn't work I need someone nearby to approve a revert. 😄 <@!301186049323958275> yes i'll be around Looks like the fixed work. https://eips.ethereum.org/networking excellent!
